Set backup password —

iOS has no Settings toggle for this — it's a computer-side setting sent directly to the device. Turning it on here is required before a backup can start (Keychain, Health, call history and saved passwords are otherwise silently omitted), and is unrelated to Finder, which can get stuck behind its own "backup was corrupt" dialog. The password is stored in the macOS Keychain, never shown again — write it down somewhere safe too.
